claimed-by-seven-immortal-kings: A night-shift cleaner touches a blood jade and wakes an ancient law — and seven immortal kings sense their lost queen is back.
craving-the-wrong-brother: Ten years loving her best friend. One crashed wedding later, it is his dangerous older brother she cannot stop thinking about.
death-game-don-t-tell-her-he-s-the-king: A broke student, a stolen golden contract, and a 'useless' partner who might be the game's hidden king.
escaped-from-eight-alphas-sold-back-by-m: Eight alphas claimed her. She chose one man and built him into an Alpha — and he sold her back.
every-night-with-the-hockey-star-in-my-d: Every night she falls into the hockey captain's dreams. Every morning, he remembers more than he should.
her-secret-lycan-king: Exiled by sunrise unless she marries tonight. The stranger she saved says yes — and he is not what he seems.
island-game-my-ceo-s-obsession: He sold one masked night to pay his father's debt — and woke the Alpha who turns out to be his new boss.
live-for-us-alexander-the-great: A modern doctor saves Alexander the Great in 323 BC — and 2,000 years later the world needs him to do it again.
love-me-or-lose-everything: He tested her love like a game, and her family paid for it with everything. Now the heir learns what regret costs.
marrying-my-ex-s-mafia-brother: He announced his engagement to someone else at her birthday solo. She kissed his mafia brother before the cake was cut.
mask-off: Scholarship girl by day. By night, a masked fighter one win away from the seat everyone wants.
move-aside-i-m-the-true-dragon-awakener: A servant's daughter stole her name, her title and her dragon. The real Awakener is done hiding.
my-alpha-killed-me-so-i-let-his-lover-di: Her mate murdered her and their unborn pup for another woman. Reborn at day one, the healer lets his lover die this time.
my-cursed-merman-husband-rules-the-deep: Seven brides died on their wedding nights. The eighth just walked in — and the 'disabled monster' duke is hiding fins.
one-dollar-one-chance-one-family-saved: Reborn at eight years old with one coin and a lifetime of regret, he is going to bankrupt every crooked casino that ruined his family.
pay-me-or-lose-me: The ghost-singer died for the star she made famous. Reborn with a system that turns heartthrobs into her medicine, she is collecting what she is owed.
step-on-me-i-ll-crush-you-all: They tried to buy a powerful mother's silence for $2 million. She is about to show them what her family is actually worth.

the-luna-he-gave-away: The Alpha King handed his unwanted Luna to his outcast brother. The bond snapped into place the second they met.
the-magicless-archmage-and-the-iron-grai: Born with zero magic and mocked as a servant — until an ancient grail chooses him over every noble in the academy.
the-mermaid-princess-s-pirate-king-husba: A mermaid princess on the run trades a contract marriage to the Pirate King — the safest monster she could find.

the-oracle-s-awakening-my-ex-husband-beg: The Sun God threw away his wife — and the secret power quietly holding his whole realm together. Now he is cursed, dying, and begging.
the-queen-behind-his-throne: She built his mafia empire for five years. He humiliated her in public. She withdrew $68 million and disappeared.
